title: Launch wordmark, mixed materials
content:
Create a minimalist 16:9 launch graphic on a pure warm-white background with enormous amounts of clean negative space.
Centered composition.
Top line: the exact word "ChatGPT" in very large, clean, black modern sans-serif typography.
Directly underneath it: the exact text "Images 2.5".
Each individual character in "Images 2.5" must be rendered as a completely different physical or artistic medium while still remaining immediately readable as the correct letter.
Despite the wildly different materials, preserve perfect baseline alignment, spacing and legibility.
No extra decorative elements, no additional text.
